title: Hunting APT29 TTPs: Lateral Movement via WMI
excerpt: Full investigation of an APT29 campaign exploiting WMI and DCOM for lateral movement in an Active Directory environment. Hunt hypotheses, detection, and Sigma rules.
tldr: APT29 uses persistent WMI subscriptions to execute payloads on remote hosts. This post covers the hunt methodology, key artifacts, and resulting detection rules.
